recommended_approach: Mantaflow gas Domain + Flow source setup for fire, using a FLUID modifier on the source (fluid_type='FLOW', flow_type='BOTH') and a volume material on the domain for rendering.
warnings: Domain is required and defines the simulation volume and global simulation settings.
At least one Flow object is required per simulation.
The domain must have a material assigned for rendering.
Smoke can accumulate and fill the entire domain if not controlled.
OpenVDB export can fail or produce invalid output.
alternative_approaches: Shader Nodes + Volume Components based flame lookdev instead of a full Mantaflow bake.
Principled/Shader Nodes based emissive-volume flame treatment for a close-up shot.
